figures.title: Initiating diagnostic
figures.headline: A single design symptom opens the research question.
figures.caveat: Illustrative initiating case, not a final design.

figures.title: Dependency network
figures.headline: Variables interact through hydraulics, geometry, stability and foundation response.
figures.caveat: Conceptual dependency map; not an estimated causal DAG.

figures.title: Experiment scale and filtering

population_and_filter.population: 50,000 whole-system base plus specialist analytical populations

figures.headline: 50,000 whole-system; 2,585 competent-rock/Pareto-eligible; 101 nondominated; 22,500 jump states; 25,000 alluvial states; 14,369 BJ–DAF overlap.

figures.title: Q × L head response
figures.method: exact H=[Q/(C L)]^(2/3), no regression and no raster reconstruction
figures.headline: Exact elasticities: Q +2/3; L −2/3; C −2/3.
figures.caveat: Exact within the selected broad-crested formulation; applicability limits are separate.

figures.title: q × Fr1 forcing response

population_and_filter.population: pooled four-seed eligible synthetic relationship; q/Fr1 ranges from whole-system coverage

figures.method: replicated log-response gradient plus Sobol context
figures.headline: P′ ∝ q^1.67 Fr1^1.87; R²≈0.9999; +10% q≈+17%; +10% Fr1≈+19.5%.
figures.caveat: Research response relationship, not a final basin-design equation.
figures.interactivity: animated response surface/contours and sensitivity callouts

figures.title: Height × slope body-area response

population_and_filter.population: analytical identity over study parameter ranges

figures.headline: Height dominates global body-area variance; slope is second; top width is small.
figures.caveat: Body area is a material proxy, not reinforcement or foundation quantity.
figures.interactivity: live geometry morph with sensitivity bars

figures.title: Conditional stability drivers

population_and_filter.population: four-seed applicability-conditioned stability subsets; about 8,914 pooled eligible observations across replications
population_and_filter.filter: only states where the diagnostic stability response is applicable

figures.method: pooled standardized multivariable diagnostic regression; summarize coefficient range across four seeds
figures.headline: Cohesion +0.629; height −0.256; downstream slope +0.167; Q −0.090; tailwater ≈+0.071; pooled R²≈0.876.
figures.caveat: Diagnostic only: no universal elasticity, no field factor-of-safety equation, no unconditional stability Sobol.

figures.title: Pareto trade space

population_and_filter.filter: four objectives minimized simultaneously; runtime shows deterministic 50-point subset of the 101 frontier

figures.method: four-objective nondominance: body area, forcing, |yt/y2−1|, rock Pav/Pc
figures.headline: 101 nondominated cases; no scalar winner.
figures.interactivity: objective brushing, highlight/fade, no best-design badge

figures.title: Normalized family map

population_and_filter.population: 10,317 pooled eligible cases across four seeds; point display uses deterministic 60-state sample from source seed while envelopes are pooled

figures.method: fuzzy B/P–T/P occupancy plus pooled p10/p50/p90 normalized hydraulic/geometry/loading envelopes
figures.headline: F1≈5.2%, F2≈15.1%, F3≈31.5%, F4≈48.2%.
figures.caveat: Research families are fuzzy behavioural envelopes; F1 is especially a transition family.
figures.interactivity: family morph, point/envelope toggle, coordinated highlighting

figures.title: Family trade-off dashboard

population_and_filter.population: 10,317 pooled eligible cases summarized by family

figures.method: pooled percentile trade-off matrix and relative performance scores
figures.headline: Families exchange material, forcing, tailwater mismatch, foundation threshold and stability diagnostics rather than producing one winner.
figures.caveat: Synthetic trade-offs, not economic or site-specific optima.

figures.title: Family-share replication

population_and_filter.population: four independent 50K seeds; 10,317 total eligible family-assigned cases

figures.headline: Family occupancy changes only modestly across independent seeds.
figures.caveat: Stable occupancy does not imply fixed Pareto membership.

figures.title: Hydraulic-jump development demand

population_and_filter.filter: 4.5≤Fr1≤9; runtime retains deterministic 60-point curve plus full p10/p50/p90 summaries

figures.method: standard conjugate-depth/energy relations plus CWC=5(y2−y1) and USACE natural-length reference scaling
figures.headline: At median Fr1≈6.75: y2/y1≈9.06, ΔE/y1≈14.45, CWC≈40.30, USACE≈54.0; CWC/USACE rises ≈0.70–0.78 over domain.
figures.caveat: Reference scaling only; not final IS 4997:2026 basin dimensions.
figures.interactivity: Fr1 scrubber animating depth, energy and reference lengths

figures.title: BJ vs DAF alluvial comparison

population_and_filter.population: 25,000 alluvial states; 14,369 common positive/partial-range comparison states
population_and_filter.filter: comparison_overlap==true; runtime uses deterministic 30-point display, full-population headline statistics and all five exact DAF elasticities

figures.method: full-overlap Spearman/ratio diagnostics plus exact DAF finite-change elasticities
figures.headline: Median DAF/BJ≈1.107; Spearman≈0.422; 50.3% within factor 2; 86.1% within factor 5; p10–p90≈0.351–5.846.
figures.caveat: Structured model disagreement is not site validation and neither equation is treated as truth.
figures.interactivity: scatter/ratio bands with DAF term-effect controls

figures.title: Alluvial disagreement envelope

population_and_filter.filter: validated out-of-fold disagreement population; runtime uses deterministic 30-state display plus complete calibration summaries

figures.method: preferred v0.3 disagreement envelope: jet velocity, yt/H, d90/d50, d50, b/B, unit q, plus centered-log yt/H × d50 interaction
figures.headline: Overall q10–q90 coverage≈0.801; regime accuracy≈0.878; high-confidence accuracy≈0.982.
figures.caveat: Meta-model of model disagreement, not a physical scour equation.
figures.interactivity: uncertainty ribbon, family/filter controls, calibration-state transitions

figures.title: Global Sobol sensitivity

population_and_filter.population: dedicated scrambled Sobol/Jansen design with base N=8192 on validated response surrogates
population_and_filter.filter: runtime publishes top 3 effects per principal response plus full scramble replication summary

figures.method: S1/ST with 95% intervals and independent scramble check
figures.headline: Head Q ST≈0.621; forcing Fr1≈0.512; jump Fr1≈0.809; body-area height≈0.829; rock logPav≈0.675.
figures.caveat: Indices are specific to frozen synthetic ranges; stability is intentionally excluded from unconditional Sobol.
figures.interactivity: response selector, S1/ST reorder, interval whiskers

figures.title: Five-dimension synthesis
figures.method: integrated synthesis across hydraulics, geometry/stability and foundation/scour
figures.headline: Normalized response regime; response magnitude; dissipation-development demand; material/stability trade-off; foundation/scour uncertainty.
figures.caveat: Research framework, not a design code.
